newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land falls below placement price.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land falls below placement price.

text.p: Property based DBS Land shares fell to a low of Singapore $4.74 in late trading on Wednesday.
Dealers said sentiment for the stock was weak after it announced a large placement of 91.9 million shares at S$4.75 each on Tuesday.
DBS Land shares ended at S$4.76 on Wednesday, down 24 cents on active volume of more thanr 4.5 million shares.
"The placement was too large and most probably the price was pushed up before the placement anyway," said a broker with a local firm.
He said the stock should have limited downside from current levels. "But the market needs to digest the placement before the share price can recover."
DBS Land said it planned to raise S$428 million from the placement to part finance its proposed acquisition of a 19.2 percent stake in healthcare group Parkway Holdings Ltd.
"I think there is some concern about dilution of earnings from the placement. But the dilution is actually very small, about three to five percent," said an analyst with European broking firm.
